Muted dusty teal, pale slate blue, warm ivory, small faded terracotta touches, cobalt blue #174ea6 as the accent. Entirely flat, compact and quiet, no realistic depth, cast shadows, glow, photography, scenery, faces, labels, letters, digits, words, logos, watermark or UI. Genuine transparent background around every shape. No rectangular background plane. Crisp enough to read at 80–160 CSS pixels.
Asset type: one small personal illustration beside a short paragraph about training in the gym. Subject: ONE simple horizontal 2D dumbbell. A slim slate-grey handle connecting two pairs of broad rounded rectangular muted teal weight plates, a small cobalt-blue endcap or ink edge on each side, a little ivory highlight. Clear simple silhouette, gentle printed grain, no weight numbers, no perspective, no arm, no hand, no equipment scene. Centered with ample transparent padding in a square canvas. Keep the silhouette compact and friendly, like a tiny handmade print, ready for a brief CSS lifting animation.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied curriculum illustration to be much simpler and quieter. Replace the two busy sheets and detailed smartphone mockup with ONE small flat warm-ivory paper offcut, almost empty. On it, only three small broad printed blocks in muted dusty teal and pale slate, one thin cobalt-blue #174ea6 margin rule, and two very short blue annotation strokes. Composition: a single coherent sheet tilted only slightly, centered in a square canvas with lots of genuinely transparent padding. Medium: restrained flat editorial screen print with delicate pigment grain, like a little paper fragment from an abstract book cover. Avoid stock educational illustration styling. Keep the texture soft and subtle. No smartphone, app mockup, realistic interface, check badges, circles with ticks, decorative rays, loops, arrow, curled line, pen, multiple pages, handwriting, text, letters, numbers, logo, 3D, perspective, cast shadow, glow or background plane. The entire artwork is one nearly empty printed paper fragment. Preserve the muted palette and transparent background of the reference.

motion.dumbbell: Five CSS poses in one 320ms lift on hover; one bitmap keeps every pose consistent.
motion.archive: Three separately rendered cards fan slightly over 220ms.
motion.preferences: All new hover motion is gated to fine-pointer hover and prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. No loops or added focus stops.

optimization: Alpha-preserving cell extraction and padding normalization, resized to at most 480px and encoded as WebP quality 90. Atlas cells are exported as independent layers; the original illustration texture is preserved.
